parts.name: Wheel (Left)
parts.Basic_description: This is the left wheel of the trashcan, made of durable rubber for mobility and shock absorption.
parts.Functional_description: It allows the trashcan to be rolled easily when tilted, providing smooth movement over surfaces.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates around its axle to enable rolling motion.

parts.name: Wheel (Right)
parts.Basic_description: This is the right wheel of the trashcan, made of rubber and attached to the base for mobility.
parts.Functional_description: It works together with the left wheel to support and move the trashcan smoothly.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates around its axle to enable rolling motion.

parts.name: Lid
parts.Basic_description: This is the lid of the trashcan, made of HDPE plastic, designed to cover the opening.
parts.Functional_description: It prevents odors from escaping and keeps debris or rainwater from entering the trashcan.
parts.Movement_description: It pivots around a hinge to open and close.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the main body of the trashcan, made of HDPE plastic, forming the container for waste storage.
parts.Functional_description: It holds and supports the waste, providing structural integrity and attachment points for the lid and wheels.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary while the wheels and lid move relative to it.
